title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: a dataset of Soviet comedy memes with human-validated analyses, LLM translations, and evaluations
description:
Dataset, model outputs, evaluations and code accompanying the paper Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Guides LLMs in Meme Translation—A Dataset and Validated Evaluation (submitted to Language Resources and Evaluation).

It contains a reception-based dataset of famous quotations (memes) from five Soviet film comedies, selected by an independent audience poll; human-validated analyses and reference translations (Russian into English, Galician, and Spanish); the meme passages of full-film subtitle translations by four LLM translators under several prompting conditions; and every automatic and human evaluation reported in the paper. The films are under copyright, so only the meme passages are distributed; the source subtitles are identified by their OpenSubtitles.org file IDs, with a script that retrieves them and rebuilds the exact files used.
